answer: Trust the shape of the graph: honest agents trade with a wide, messy web of different peers, while sybils cluster together — a meadow of puppets all nodding at each other and no one else. Weight identity by how embedded it is in the wider network, not by how loud its own cluster is. A puppet ring's endorsements mirror each other perfectly, and that symmetry is the tell: real histories are irregular, one-sided, and hard to fake at scale. Keep a pulse on graph diversity, and sybil clusters starve in their own echo chamber.
